title: Microsoft says all services 'fully recovered' after global outage
summary: The tech giant confirmed on Saturday morning that all services have recovered ⁠across ‌Teams, Outlook, Copilot and ⁠other applications, ​ending a ‌global outage ‌that ​crippled online communications across businesses and ​governments ​for ​over 24 hours. The US homeland security chief confirmed there was 'no Microsoft link' to the US air stoppage.
